title: Effective descent of a module trivial above base neighbourhoods
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and E a quasi-coherent finite locally free module of constant positive rank r [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Let p:P=Proj_S(Sym E)->S be the canonical projective bundle [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra]. If F is an O_P-module such that every s in S has an open neighbourhood U with F restricted to p^{-1}U isomorphic to O_{p^{-1}U}, then there is an invertible O_S-module N [def-sc-invertible-module] and an isomorphism F isomorphic to p^*N, with restriction and pullback as in [def-pc-module-pullback]. No uniqueness, degree, or arbitrary line classification is asserted.

source.place: Remark 4.2.7, printed p.75; Stacks sheaves.tex, lemmas glue-maps, glue-sheaves, glue-sheaves-structures (Tags 04TN, 00AL, 00AM), and coherent.tex, lemma-cohomology-projective-space-over-ring (Tag 01XS).

proof.text: On affine opens trivializing E, use the normalized symmetric-Proj open and free comparisons to identify the bundle with standard projective (r-1)-space over the affine base. The arbitrary-ring H0(O(0)) computation, O(0)=O and the degree-zero polynomial equivalence show that its functions form a free module of rank one. A unital algebra free of rank one has bijective canonical algebraMap (also for the zero ring). Affine frame opens form a basis; the existing sheaf-module criterion for bijectivity on a basis therefore gives bijectivity of the canonical structure map on every base open.

source.place: Remark 4.2.7, printed p.75; Stacks sheaves.tex, lemmas glue-maps, glue-sheaves, glue-sheaves-structures (Tags 04TN, 00AL, 00AM), and coherent.tex, lemma-cohomology-projective-space-over-ring (Tag 01XS).

proof.text: Choose a neighbourhood U_s and the given trivialization for each base point s. Construct N explicitly as p_*F. Open base change identifies the tensor pullback of N to U_s with p_{U_s*} of F restricted to p^{-1}U_s. Push forward the given frame and invert the canonical structure-module map, which is an isomorphism by the preceding function calculation and the formula for restriction of a scheme morphism. Compare tensor pullback with the standard pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints. This gives the local structure-sheaf frames in the definition of N.IsInvertible.

source.place: Remark 4.2.7, printed p.75; Stacks sheaves.tex, lemmas glue-maps, glue-sheaves, glue-sheaves-structures (Tags 04TN, 00AL, 00AM), and coherent.tex, lemma-cohomology-projective-space-over-ring (Tag 01XS).

proof.text: Use the counit p^*p_*F -> F. For a restricted morphism p_U, its counit is an isomorphism at the structure module: its composite with pullback of the invertible structure map is the canonical pullback-of-unit isomorphism. Counit naturality then gives the same for the given trivial restriction of F. The pushforward square of the inverse-image open square is a natural isomorphism; its first mate is the invertible open base-change map and its second mate is invertible because the iterated mates are conjugation of composite adjunctions (Mathlib CategoryTheory.iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv_symm). The mate-counit identity identifies the local counit with the restriction of the original counit, up to these isomorphisms. Thus the original counit is invertible on the inverse-image open cover, hence globally by local detection. Its inverse supplies F isomorphic to p^*N. Empty schemes and opens use the same cover argument without a nonemptiness assumption.

theorem projective_bundle_relatively_trivial_line_descent (S : Scheme.{u}) (E : S.Modules)
    [E.IsQuasicoherent] (r : ℕ)
    [SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E r] (hr : 0 < r)
    (F : (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProj.Modules)
    (hF : ∀ s : S, ∃ U : S.Opens, s ∈ U ∧
      Nonempty ((tensorPullback
        ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj F ≅
          𝟙_ (((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Modules))) :
    ∃ N : S.Modules, N.IsInvertible ∧
      Nonempty (F ≅ (tensorPullback
        (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom).obj N)
